reasons: The candidate derives dropped connections as accepted minus handled from two separate metrics. No single OTel metric measures dropped connections, so the rules require blocking with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING and the expression belongs in notes, not promql.
The accepted-connections selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but its definition and dataset_types are sum, so the selector would match no series.
The Datadog template variable $Host (prefix host, default *) should become host=~"$Host", but the candidate drops it, so the series set differs.
Outcome should be blocked, not translated.
